He contacted a fake seal vendor, provided imprint text, and had them privately carved. He then possessed six forged seals. This is forging and selling state? Actually these are company seals, not state documents. The list includes "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" (for forging state documents) and "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章" (for forging company seals). Also "伪造、变造居民身份证". The appropriate label is "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章". The facts also involve possibly selling? He made them for his own business need, not necessarily selling. The charge likely is forging company seals. So answer: [罪名]伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章<eoa>
